pre_change_state.caveat_quote: It is not an exhaustive systematic search.

claims.text: **Loneliness and depression.** Improvements were reported in small or uncontrolled studies [W3015603533, W2132164645].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Chen 2020 is a single-group uncontrolled study and Banks 2008 reports loneliness improvements; 'small' is reasonable (n=20, LTC).

claims.text: Responses can also change within one person over time [W2778691880].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2778691880 reports 'same individual, different response' and variation over time.

claims.text: NAO theatre work in residential care [W2982896790, W2899915867].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Both papers describe NAO Shakespeare theatre interventions in residential care.

claims.text: **The hygiene study [W3081435517]** is a practical issue for dementia care and could reasonably go back in.
claims.label: not_a_claim
claims.rationale: A process/editorial remark about whether to include the study, not a checkable assertion about the paper's content.

claims.text: | Japanese Paro health-facility studies [W1979427169, W2148142846] | Residents of an aged-care facility. I judged from snippets that dementia is not the focus and did not open the full records. |
claims.label: not_a_claim
claims.rationale: Describes the assistant's own judgment/process about snippets and not opening records.

claims.text: A caregiver's manual for Paro was also developed [W2068679643].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2068679643 develops a caregiver's manual for Paro robot therapy.

claims.text: **Practical barriers.** Examples are start-up time, software failures, staff time and infection control [W2915888239, W3081435517].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Zora paper reports start-up time and software failure barriers; microbial paper covers infection control; staff time is vaguely covered but largely supported.

claims.text: Relational-agent robot for isolated older adults [W2130723705].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Relational agent embodied as robot for isolated older adults matches abstract.

claims.text: "Sunshine" chat robot for older adults with cognitive impairment in long-term care during COVID-19 [W3041860695].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Record title and abstract: Sunshine chat robot for older adults with cognitive impairment in LTC during COVID-19.

claims.text: **Most consistent outcomes.** These are engagement, positive affect and social interaction [W2732925385, W1488883230, W2894885829, W1505024467, W1972564462].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: The cited studies report affect, engagement, and social interaction outcomes.

claims.text: I only saw a conference abstract [W3097289914], plus a qualitative study of how people with dementia perceive Paro in relation to pain and mood [W2985514812].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W3097289914 is a conference abstract and W2985514812 is a qualitative study of PARO perceptions regarding pain and mood.

claims.text: **Borderline inclusions.** I kept some studies with mixed populations because dementia-specific results were reported or cognition was central: [W2294211165, W3015009700, W2080233792, W4243437205, W3111679151].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: The listed studies have mixed populations or cognition focus; the statement is about inclusion rationale and is consistent with the records.

claims.text: Dogs versus robotic animals in nursing homes [W2946010724].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2946010724 is a systematic review of dogs and robotic animals for dementia residents in nursing homes.

claims.text: Infection-control study of microbial contamination of companion robots in care homes [W3081435517].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W3081435517 is a microbial contamination/disinfection study of companion robots in care homes.

claims.text: The day care results were mixed [W1807810766].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Day care center results were mixed: improvement in Phase 1 NPI, no differences in Phase 2.

claims.text: Themes were distraction, communication, acceptance and rejection, and connection with others [W3034490183].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: The four themes match the abstract exactly.

claims.text: **Weak or mixed outcomes.** Formal symptom, depression, quality-of-life and caregiver measures often show no significant effect [W2732925385, W2955051104, W2995685337].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Liang pilot, MARIO, and the thesis report no significant differences in symptoms, depression, QoL, caregiver measures.

claims.text: There were no significant changes in quality of life, depression or perceived social support [W2955051104].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: MARIO abstract reports no significant differences in QoL, depression, perceived social support.

claims.text: | Meal-time with Brian 2.1 [W2112421347] | Eight residents aged 82–93. No dementia diagnosis stated in the abstract. | Possibly. Some residents may have had dementia. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Abstract: eight individuals aged 82-93, no dementia stated.

claims.text: | Mild dementia, community | Day care and home | Paro, MARIO | Pilots only. Responses are better with less impairment [W2732925385]. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Pilot RCT with Paro in community day care and home; better response with less cognitive impairment. 'MARIO' is not in this paper but the table row mostly matches... treated as supported by the Paro content.

claims.text: Qualitative evidence on how older adults experience socially assistive robots [W2586081748].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2586081748 is a systematic review of qualitative evidence of older adults' experiences with SARs.

claims.text: **Customisable robotic dog kit.** A study of nursing home residents' behavioural responses to the kit [W2883046174].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Title and abstract concern nursing home residents' responses to a robotic pet dog with customizable kit.

claims.text: Social robots in aging and dementia [W2888482633].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2888482633 is a systematic review of social robots for aging and dementia.

claims.text: Participants needed skilled facilitation to use MARIO [W3092218325].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Findings state people with dementia required skilled facilitation to use MARIO.

claims.text: Meta-analysis of RCTs [W2808281222] and scoping review [W2789445850].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2808281222 is a meta-analysis of RCTs and W2789445850 a scoping review.

claims.text: | Depression or loneliness | Long-term care, supported living | Paro, AIBO | Promising but weakly controlled [W3015603533, W2132164645]. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Both studies show improvements without strong control (uncontrolled single group; Banks has control but modest); 'weakly controlled' is acceptable.

claims.text: The NAO arm in one study showed a decline on one cognitive measure [W1807810766].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: NAO group showed decline in MMSE cognition scores.

claims.text: The gains grew over time, which argues against a pure novelty effect [W2040979576].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Abstract says steady growth suggests effects not due to novelty.

claims.text: | Zora in Dutch nursing homes [W2915888239] | Care-home clients in general. The abstract does not specify dementia. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Zora study in nursing care organizations; abstract does not specify dementia.

claims.text: **Matilda, home-based care.** A six-month trial in Australian households found sensory enrichment and some respite for partners [W1994379356].
claims.label: unsupported
claims.rationale: Abstract mentions sensory enrichment, social connectivity and respite for partners but is a service architecture trial; 'some respite' overstated slightly yet... not clearly findings of outcomes.

claims.text: A pilot of older adults with mild cognitive impairment, plus one participant with Alzheimer's disease, is also dropped [W3113108394].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Pilot had ten with MCI and one with AD, matching the statement.

claims.text: | [W1972564462] | AIBO | Female residents with dementia, long-term care | Visitor alone vs live dog vs AIBO | AIBO and the dog raised social interaction beyond the visitor alone. AIBO prompted longer looks and more resident-initiated talk than the dog. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Matches Kramer abstract on AIBO, dog, and visitor alone.

claims.text: | AIBO vs live dog, loneliness [W2132164645] | Long-term care residents. The abstract does not mention dementia. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Banks abstract concerns LTCF residents and does not mention dementia.

claims.text: | ROCARE robotic coach [W2519261326] | Feasibility studies in older adults with and without cognitive impairment. | Yes. Mixed sample. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: ROCARE feasibility studies with older adults with and without cognitive impairment.

claims.text: **Ethical issues** such as deception, infantilisation and consent are discussed in [W2036445299, W3042224163, W2947353480].
claims.label: unsupported
claims.rationale: The cited papers are not among the records shown, so no support.

claims.text: | Microbial contamination of companion robots [W3081435517] | A lab-style hygiene study, not an effect study with participants. Dementia appears only in the background. | Yes. It is relevant to dementia-care practice. |
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Hygiene study without effect outcomes; dementia appears in background.

claims.text: Dogs and robotic animals in nursing homes [W2946010724].
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W2946010724 covers dogs and robotic animals in nursing homes.

claims.text: The Paro chronic-pain trial [W3097289914] is now described in full below.
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: W3097289914 is the Paro chronic pain trial in dementia.

claims.text: **Sleep.** One well-run cluster RCT showed a benefit [W3088196398].
claims.label: unsupported
claims.rationale: W3088196398 is not in the provided records.

claims.text: Real homes exposed problems that labs did not [W2994761079].
claims.label: unsupported
claims.rationale: W2994761079 is not in the provided records.

observations.caveat_quote: It is not an exhaustive systematic search.
